defect.description: The schema-v2 alpha promotion contract admitted only canonical_promotion (evidence_grade gate_candidate, all surfaces canonical_pit) and research_replay (evidence_grade lead, at least one research_pit surface). The AGENTS.md section 5 evidence ladder step 'settled_forward_sufficient -> observed_only attribution' had no admission class, so a predeclared settled-forward observed-only attribution whose frozen reopen bars matured could not reserve an alpha_search experiment at all.
defect.trigger_case: intraday_triage_completed_close_settlement lane became ready on 2026-07-30 (142 strict effective next-close settlements, 24 active machine-default REDUCE_RISK, halves 9/15 against the frozen 100/20/5/5 contract from exp-20260714-010/exp-20260725-001/002/003); the predeclared 2026-07-24 candidate re-frozen via amendment lineage passed D0-D3 in a fresh scope but build-promotion failed with promotion_evidence_grade_mismatch.
defect.before_error: promotion_evidence_grade_mismatch: selected candidate must be gate_candidate or research-PIT lead

requirements: selected candidate evidence_grade must be observed_only
every referenced surface pit_status must be settled_forward_sufficient or canonical_pit
at least one referenced surface must be settled_forward_sufficient with source_contract_status pass and settled_count > 0
bound proposal change_type must be observed_only_attribution
result_ceiling observed_only and paper_live_eligible false, enforced at build, reserve, claim revalidation, and registry closeout
repair.registry_ceiling: scripts/experiment_registry.py _research_replay_metadata now recognises both research-boundary admission classes and applies the identical observed_only closeout ceiling and nested-authority rejection to settled_forward_attribution.

production_impact.summary: Admission governance only; no trading, outcome, or ledger semantics changed. The new class grants strictly weaker authority than research_replay-admitted work: identical observed_only ceiling, no paper/live eligibility.
